class Solution:
    def solve(self, head):
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        
        even_head = ListNode(0)
        odd_head = ListNode(0)
        even = even_head
        odd = odd_head
        node = head
        
        while node:
            if node.val % 2 == 0:
                even.next = node
                even = even.next
            else:
                odd.next = node
                odd = odd.next
            node = node.next
        
        even.next = odd_head.next
        odd.next = None
        return even_head.next
